skill.summary: 超级个体培养支撑体系；家庭赋能线（投资者思维+赋能型教养）+ 亲子关系线（良性关系+有效沟通）+ 内核能量线（能量保护+自驱激发）；培养探索力/自驱力/内核能量/人生方向/自信心

latestVersion.changelog:
parent-child-relation-model 1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive parent-child relationship and empowerment model.
- Provides a system for cultivating “super individuals” focusing on exploration, self-drive, core energy, life direction, and confidence.
- Combines three support lines: family empowerment (investor mindset, enabling parenting), parent-child relationship (healthy connections, effective communication), and core energy (energy protection, self-drive stimulation).
- Includes multi-layer diagnosis tools, intervention models, and structured output templates for deep analysis and actionable solutions.
- Offers resource links and ready-to-use frameworks for systemic family education upgrades.
